subject: using custom-made cdf packages from R

messages.author: 20445ae12be3516b
messages.subject: using custom-made cdf packages from R
parts:
Hi,

I am working with an custom-made annotation of an Affymetrix GeneChip,
which is available to me as an R package only (there is no cdf-file
made so far). Can I somehow use this for aroma.affymetrix?
If not, does anyone know how to create a cdf-file from an R
environment?

Thanks for any help, Sam

Samuel Wuest
Trinity College Dublin

messages.author: 43e2e19dd6bd2992
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] using custom-made cdf packages from R
parts:
Hi Sam,
If you are interested in making a cdf Mark and I have some code that
will do that. It takes a tab-deliminated file, giving the group and unit
identification of each probe along with x,y coordinates. For example,
Probe_ID X Y Probe_Sequence Group_ID Unit_ID
15 14 0 TCTCCAGTGAAGTGCACATTGCTCA 3029044
ENSG00000106144
17 16 0 TGATCGCCTGTCTGCAGATAGGGCA 2400195
ENSG00000090432
20 19 0 ACTTTGTTGCTTTAGCTGAGGTAGA 2482762
ENSG00000214595
29 28 0 TGTAGCTACATGAGGTCTCAGCAGT 2690968
ENSG00000121577

where X,Y,Group_ID and Unit_ID are the only necessary columns currently.
Is this of interest?
Best,
Elizabeth
